pins.title: Beach nature walk for kids: follow the last high tide line
pins.description: What made the line of shells and seaweed on the beach? The last high tide left them behind. On a safe beach walk with a grown-up, follow the line parallel to the water and describe three natural finds. Leave them in place. Try the free Tide-Line Detective activity.
